cards.name: Dice Jar
cards.effect: Both players roll a six-sided die. The player with the lower result takes damage equal to the opponent's result × 500; if the winner rolled a 6, the loser takes 6000. If tied, both roll again.
cards.sourceVerification: secondary text/date cross-check; Konami database identifier recorded, direct page retrieval not confirmed

cards.name: Fire Sorcerer
cards.effect: FLIP: Banish 2 random cards from your hand; inflict 800 damage to your opponent.
cards.sourceVerification: secondary text/date cross-check; Konami database identifier recorded, direct page retrieval not confirmed

behavior: Both effects require a real face-down-to-face-up event (Flip Summon, battle, or card effect); controller team/active seat and source physical owner are captured separately.
Dice Jar compares 1–6 results for both teams, rerolls both on ties, damages the lower-rolling team by the higher result × 500, and uses 6000 when the higher result is 6.

Fire Sorcerer uses exactly two RNG-selected UIDs from the active controller's private hand, moves them to that team's shared banished zone, and deals 800 to the opposing team; fewer than two cards means no partial banish or damage.
A queued FLIP trigger may resolve after its source leaves the field; negation causes no damage or banishment.
All physical UIDs remain unchanged; no card is created, granted, or discarded by the hand-limit rule during Main Phase.

rules.physicalOwnership: UID m0–m3 remains attached to original physical seat
